en: There, that should do it...
Thank you, Stay.

jp: ちょっと、まだ動かないでよ！！
en: Hey, don't move yet!!

jp: 運良く助かったけれど
この傷、あと少しずれていたら
死んでたかもしれないのよ！！
en: You got lucky. A little to one side and this wound could've killed you!!

jp: ごめんなさい、私は・・・
en: Stay... I'm sorry, I...

jp: また教団に戻るつもりなの？
en: Neesan, you're planning to go back to the Church again?
...Yes.

jp: ここにはキロタもいるのに
置いていくつもりなの？
en: Kilota's here too, and you're going to leave us behind, Neesan?
...I'm sorry.

jp: どうして一緒にいてくれないの！
三人しかいない、家族なのよ？
en: If you're sorry, why won't you stay with us! We're family, the only three of us left!

jp: 姉さんは、あの人をとるの？
en: And still you choose him, Neesan?

jp: 姉さんが、あの人のことを・・
en: I know, you know. How you feel about him...

jp: いつか貴方にもわかる日がくるわ
en: Someday you'll understand too.

jp: そんなのわからなくていいわよ！
en: I don't want to understand!

jp: あの人のところに行くの？
en: You'd throw away your family to go to him?

jp: 絶対に振り返ってもらえないって
わかっているのに・・・
それなのに、どうしてっ！！
en: You know he'll never so much as look your way... So why!!

jp: でも、行かなくては・・・
en: I'm sorry. But I have to go...
Don't go, Neesan!

jp: 辛そうな目をしたまま
あんな人、忘れちゃってよ！！
en: If you're going to smile with that pain in your eyes, just forget him!!

jp: あたしやキロタと一緒にいよう
その方が姉さんも幸せなはずよ！
en: Stay here with me and Kilota. You'd be happier that way, Neesan!
That man... is always alone.

jp: 背負い込んでしまうの
en: He shoulders everything by himself.

jp: 貴方には貴方を支えてくれる
たくさんの人達がいるわ
en: Stayen, you have so many people to support you.

jp: お姉ちゃんがいなくても
en: You'll be fine without your big sis now, won't you?

jp: そんなことない・・・
あたしなんか、全然ダメよ・・
en: That's not true... I'm hopeless...

jp: いつも一人で暴走して・・・
みんなに迷惑かけて・・・
en: Always running wild on my own... charging ahead... causing everyone trouble...

jp: そんな貴方を優しく受け止めて
en: But the people around you accept you gently all the same, don't they?
But... Still...

jp: もう行かなくては・・・
en: I'm sorry, Stay. I really must go...

jp: そんな身体でどこに行くのよ！？
en: Where do you think you're going in that state!?
Bale-sama is in danger.

jp: それに、私は秘密を知って
en: And I've learned a secret I shouldn't have...

jp: 貴方達にも迷惑がかかります
en: If I stay here, I'll surely bring trouble on all of you.
A secret? What on earth...
That explosion!?

jp: 絶対に、部屋から一歩も出ちゃ
en: Stay right there, Neesan!! Don't take one step out of this room!!!

jp: その話、あたし達にも聞かせて
en: When I get back, tell us the whole story.

jp: 何か出来ることがあるなら
en: If there's anything we can do, we'll help...
Stayen.
Promise me, Neesan.
